No payment is taken until you approve the plan. Common questions

On this walk you understand enclosed mosque planning and Jahanpanah urbanism.

The date, start time, pace and language are arranged to suit your group.

What it covers

  • Mosque exterior
  • Courtyard and roof logic
  • Vaulted interior, if accessible
  • Residential edge

How the time is spent

  1. Mosque exterior 15 min

    Introduce Khirki mosque and unusual plan.

    You: sketch footprint

  2. Courtyard and roof logic 30 min

    Discuss covered/open space and light.

    You: find ventilation strategy

  3. Vaulted interior, if accessible 30 min

    Compare structural bays.

    You: elevation sketch

  4. Residential edge 15 min

    Explain urban change and risk to monuments.

    You: note conservation questions

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Identify and interpret key features of Khirki Mosque using material evidence and a site map.
  • Understand enclosed mosque planning and Jahanpanah urbanism.
  • Distinguish directly visible fabric from reconstructed or debated historical claims.

You take away

Your annotated field card, sketches and notes.
